verdict.rationale: The product consists of agent-oriented docs: SKILL.md files, served at raw URLs, that tell agents how to use YYLO Ledger, run the Ralph loop and understand projects. It also ships agent plugin and marketplace metadata. These skills are designed to be installed into agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) rather than pointed at as documentation, and the docs-md probe returned 404. missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt index, a markdown docs endpoint (the .md probe 404'd), explicit guidance on pointing an agent at a docs URL, and independent corroboration.
